rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides SSH connectivity for remote server operations with support for multiple authentication methods (password, key, agent forwarding), persistent long-lived connections with automatic keepalive, and configurable session timeouts. Features include connection pooling for high-performance concurrent access, multi-host batch command execution, SFTP file transfers, Docker image building and monitoring, background task management, and structured audit logging. Supports paramiko, asyncssh, and fabric client backends.
